channel.title: Projects on Prashant K. Jha
channel.description: Recent content in Projects on Prashant K. Jha

item.title: Mechanics of granular media
item.description: Particle-resolved and multifidelity modeling of granular assemblies whose particles deform, break and rearrange under load.

item.title: Design of magnetic soft materials
item.description: Choosing where to put material and where to put magnetization, at the same time, so a soft structure moves the way a design problem asks it to.

item.title: Neural operators with error estimation and control
item.description: Residual-based estimation and correction of neural-operator error in forward simulation, Bayesian inference and topology optimization.

item.title: Failure and fatigue in magnetic soft materials
item.description: Magnetic soft composites are designed as if the particle–matrix interface were perfect. This project asks what changes when it is not, and whether that is what sets how long the material keeps working.

item.title: Interface fracture in particle composites
item.description: Effective properties for a composite have to come from somewhere. This project derives them from resolved micro-scale fracture simulations, after first settling which description of the interface to trust.

item.title: Adhesion of field-responsive materials
item.description: A pull-off force is one number describing at least four different mechanisms. Separating them is what lets a measurement support a design rule that transfers, instead of one fitted curve.

item.title: Mathematical foundations of fracture
item.description: Well-posedness, kinetic relations and convergence rates for models of dynamic fracture, and the crack behavior they predict around voids, inclusions and interfaces.

item.title: Mixed-dimensional modeling of tumor growth and angiogenesis
item.description: A mixed-dimensional model of tumor growth in which an evolving one-dimensional vascular network carries blood and nutrients through three-dimensional tissue.

item.title: Scalable solvers for computational mechanics
item.description: Parallel and asynchronous solvers, load balancing and distributed data structures for large mechanics and transport problems.
